title: Omgång 12 · vila A · blicken runt bordet
summary: Gör en vilofilm av Paow: hon sitter still, och filmen börjar och slutar på ankare 1.

step.label: Vila, samma bild först och sist

reference.why: WAN 3 tar ingen referensfilm tillsammans med första och sista bild.

prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. She starts and ends exactly as in the first frame, and holds still for the last half second. Her eyes and head turn calmly to the players at the left of the picture and rest there a moment, then move across to the players at the right of the picture, and come back to the camera. She blinks once on the way, and her shoulders turn a little with her head. Her hands rest on the felt.
